scripts.build: npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w batterylens
scripts.release: npm version patch -w batterylens --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w batterylens --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -w batterylens --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w batterylens --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major -w batterylens --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w batterylens --access public
